mentions.name: maths-game-problem-generator
mentions.description: A UK-focused library for generating curriculum-aligned maths problems that can power maths games and other educational apps, with example games such as Maths vs Monsters, Breakout Maths, and Maths Blaster.
mentions.problem: Generating random maths problems aligned to a curriculum is surprisingly difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've also previously done some work on maths problem generation.  Similar to letterpaths, the core lib can then be used to power games/other educational apps.
